action_summary.3-6s: She dips her fingers into the clear brine and holds her hand above the top-left corner of the blank sheepskin parchment.
action_summary.6-8s: A heavy drop of saltwater gathers at the tip of her index finger, quivers for an instant, and drops squarely onto the ivory surface.

scene_name: Xác nhận truyền thuyết có thật

action_summary.0-3s: From second 0, Heracles gazes at the radiant golden map with childlike wonder and speaks immediately: Heracles says "The Golden Tree of antiquity... the ancient sailor tales whispered across the seven oceans were actually real after all these years." (no subtitles).
action_summary.3-6s: His booming voice is humbled by ancient majesty; the golden light reveals the glowing emblem of a gigantic crowned tree at the center of the charted sea.

dialogue.speaker: Heracles
dialogue.line_en: The Golden Tree of antiquity... the ancient sailor tales whispered across the seven oceans were actually real after all these years.
dialogue.line_vn: Cây Vàng của thời cổ đại... những câu chuyện truyền miệng của thủy thủ trên khắp bảy đại dương hóa ra là có thật sau ngần ấy năm trời.

scene_name: Bất đồng ý kiến lộ trình

dramatic_craft.beat: [-]: Internal crew conflict over suicidal navigation.
dramatic_craft.value_turn: Awe (++) -> Tactical danger (-): The only route passes through certain death.
dramatic_craft.subtext: Castor values survival over glory; Nora values legend over fear.
dramatic_craft.prop_and_detail: Glyph of two crushing jaws etched into the glowing golden parchment.

action_summary.2-4s: His voice is loud, sharp, and clipped like an officer under combat pressure; he shakes his head adamantly, glaring at Nora.
action_summary.4-6s: His shout finishes by second 3; he holds his finger planted firmly on the map while Nora's expression remains as solid as iron.

dialogue.speaker: Castor
dialogue.line_en: This route cuts straight through the Clashing Rocks! No hull survives those jaws!
dialogue.line_vn: Hải trình này đâm thẳng qua Vách Đá Nghiền Clashing Rocks! Không có thân tàu nào sống sót qua hàm răng đá đó cả!

audio: Castor's loud clipped voice on top; table vibrating under finger tap; sea swell rocking hull timbers.

scene_name: Quyết định đâm vào vách đá

action_summary.0-3s: From second 0, Nora rolls the parchment in one continuous powerful sweep and delivers her captain's decree with fierce conviction: Nora says "We do not turn our rudder back from destiny." (no subtitles).
action_summary.3-6s: She slides the rolled map into a cylindrical bronze case and screws the threaded cap shut with an iron snap: Nora says "Ready the heavy oars and rig the thick storm-canvas immediately!" (no subtitles).
action_summary.6-8s: Her orders finish cleanly by second 6; she latches the bronze cylinder to her sword belt and strides toward the companionway with ruthless resolve.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.line_en: We do not turn our rudder back from destiny. Ready the heavy oars and rig the thick storm-canvas immediately!
dialogue.line_vn: Chúng ta không bao giờ bẻ lái quay đầu trước số phận. Chuẩn bị những mái chèo hạng nặng và giương ngay lớp buồm bão dày lên lập tức!

audio: Nora's commanding ring; metallic screw of bronze cap; solid boot strides on oak.

scene_name: Toàn tàu ứng chiến với bão

action_summary.0-3s: From second 0, as wind howls through the rigging, Heracles braces his massive legs against the deck and roars at the deckhands: Heracles says "All hands on the main deck! Lash down the water casks, batten every hatch, and prime the bilge pumps now!" (no subtitles).
action_summary.3-6s: His powerful voice booms over the gathering gale; sailors scurry across the deck in urgent coordination, hauling heavy canvas sheets.
action_summary.6-8s: Heracles knots the thick hawser with a brutal pull by second 6, testing the lashings as seafoam sprays over the starboard rail.

dialogue.speaker: Heracles
dialogue.line_en: All hands on the main deck! Lash down the water casks, batten every hatch, and prime the bilge pumps now!
dialogue.line_vn: Tất cả mọi người lên boong chính! Buộc chặt các thùng nước, đóng chặt mọi cửa hầm và mồi sẵn máy bơm đáy tàu ngay!

audio: Heracles's booming roar; howling wind whistling through shroud wires; crashing seafoam on timber.

scene_name: Con tàu lao ra đại dương

dramatic_craft.beat: [+]: Aggressive maritime navigation into dangerous currents.
dramatic_craft.value_turn: Deck preparation (0) -> Heroic assault (+): Driving directly into the vortex.
dramatic_craft.subtext: Nora attacks danger head-on; retreat is not in her blood.
dramatic_craft.prop_and_detail: Carved timber figurehead slicing waves, spray flying off taut stay ropes.

action_summary.0-3s: From second 0, as the heavy timber bow crashes into a steep ocean swell, Nora grips the stay wire and shouts into the storm: Nora says "Steer south-southwest into the towering swell! We must ride the high crest before the midnight tide turns against our hull!" (no subtitles).
action_summary.3-6s: Her fierce voice carries above the roaring sea; the wooden bow cleaves through black water, sending explosive sheets of white spray curling into the dark air.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.line_en: Steer south-southwest into the towering swell! We must ride the high crest before the midnight tide turns against our hull!
dialogue.line_vn: Bẻ lái về hướng nam-tây nam đâm vào con sóng cuộn khổng lồ! Chúng ta phải cưỡi lên đỉnh ngọn sóng cao nhất trước khi thủy triều lúc nửa đêm xoay chiều đè lên thân tàu!

scene_name: Thiên nhiên đe dọa nuốt chửng tàu

action_summary.0-3s: The pirate galleon appears as a tiny, fragile wooden shell tossed upon colossal, surging black mountain-waves under a bruised tempest sky.
action_summary.3-7s: A sudden flash of lightning tears across the storm clouds, revealing the colossal jagged black basalt pillars of the Clashing Rocks rising like mountain teeth in the distance.
action_summary.7-10s: The tiny ship plunges into a deep ocean trough, rising gallantly onto the next crest as the sea churns in violent froth.

audio: Deep rolling sonic boom of distant thunder, terrifying roar of gale winds, deep groaning abyss (Sonic Isolation: 0 words).

scene_name: Vật lộn giữ lái trước vách đá

dramatic_craft.beat: [-]: Desperate physical struggle against the vortex.

action_summary.0-3s: From second 0, with rain streaming down her face and wet copper braids whipping in the gale, Nora battles the violent kick of the oak helm and shouts: Nora says "Keep her straight in the trough! The current is dragging our oak keel toward the crushing black basalt jaws ahead!" (no subtitles).

action_summary.6-8s: She completes her command by second 6, planting her boots against the deck grating and holding the helm locked in position through pure iron will.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.line_en: Keep her straight in the trough! The current is dragging our oak keel toward the crushing black basalt jaws ahead!
dialogue.line_vn: Giữ thẳng con tàu trong rãnh sóng! Dòng hải lưu đang kéo sống tàu gỗ sồi của chúng ta về phía hàm răng đá bazan đen nghiền nát phía trước!
